cobblecomfort.config.title: Cobble Comfort
cobblecomfort.option.general.enabled.des: Master switch. When off, every feature is disabled and the game behaves like vanilla.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.enabled.desc: Lets you move, scale, style and animate vanilla HUD elements. When off, the HUD looks exactly like vanilla.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.open_editor.des: Move elements with the mouse, scale them with the scroll wheel and right-click an element for its settings.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.snapping.desc: Snap elements to screen edges, the screen centre and other elements while dragging. Hold Shift to drag freely.
How close (in GUI pixels) an edge has to be before it snaps.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.grid_size.desc: Snap to a grid of this size when nothing else is in range. 0 turns the grid off.
Resets every element to its vanilla look and position.
Status bars and the hotbar hide when nothing changes and slide back in when something does. Health and hunger pulse when low.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.preset.clean.de: Translucent rounded backgrounds behind the scoreboard, effects, subtitles and messages.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.preset.name: New preset name
cobblecomfort.option.hud.preset.name.des: Name for saving the current layout as a preset. Letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.preset.save.des: Saves all element settings as a preset in config/cobblecomfort/hud_presets. Reopen the settings to see it in the list.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.preset.user.des: A preset you saved. Applying it replaces the current layout.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.element.opacity: Transparency of the element. Items (for example in the hotbar) always stay opaque.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.element.scale.d: Size relative to vanilla. Also adjustable with the scroll wheel in the HUD editor.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.element.custom_: Use the anchor and offset below instead of the vanilla position. Turned on automatically when you drag the element.
The screen point the element is positioned against, so it stays in place when the window size changes.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.element.offset_: Horizontal distance from the anchor in GUI pixels.
Vertical distance from the anchor in GUI pixels.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.element.tint.de: Colour multiplied onto the element. White keeps the original colours.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.element.text_sh: Force the text shadow on or off for text in this element.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.element.backgro: Draw a box behind the element.
Colour and transparency of the background box.
Space between the element and the edge of the box.
Rounding of the background box corners.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.element.auto_hi: Hide the element when its content has not changed for a while and show it again as soon as it changes.
Seconds without change before the element hides.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.element.animati: How the element appears and disappears when auto-hide is on.
Length of the show/hide animation in seconds.
cobblecomfort.option.hud.element.pulse_w: Gently pulse the element when the value gets low (health 30%, hunger 3 drumsticks, air 30%).
cobblecomfort.hud.element.title: Title and subtitle
cobblecomfort.option.look.enabled.desc: Shows information about the block or entity under your crosshair. Move and scale it in the HUD editor.
Show info for mobs, players, items on the ground and other entities.
cobblecomfort.option.look.show_fluids.de: Also show water and lava you are looking at.
cobblecomfort.option.look.only_when_snea: Only show the info while you hold the sneak key.
cobblecomfort.option.look.hide_in_specta: Do not show the info in spectator mode.
cobblecomfort.option.look.show_icon.desc: Show the block's item or the entity's spawn egg.
Show which mod the block or entity comes from.
cobblecomfort.option.look.show_harvest_t: Show the matching tool and whether your held item can harvest the block.
cobblecomfort.option.look.show_growth.de: Show the growth of crops and other growing blocks.
Show the power level of redstone dust and other powered blocks.
cobblecomfort.option.look.show_break_pro: Show a progress bar while you mine the block.
cobblecomfort.option.look.show_block_sta: Show all raw block state properties (facing, waterlogged, …). Useful for building.
cobblecomfort.option.look.max_hearts.des: Entities with more hearts than this show their health as a number instead.
cobblecomfort.option.look.show_entity_de: Baby, tamed and owner, villager profession and level, item stack size.
cobblecomfort.option.look.show_horse_sta: Show speed and jump height of horses, donkeys and similar mounts.
cobblecomfort.option.look.layout.desc: Panel: a box with icon and detail lines. Compact: a single line without a box.
cobblecomfort.option.look.background_col: Colour and transparency of the panel.
cobblecomfort.option.look.border.desc: Draw a border around the panel.
cobblecomfort.option.look.border_color_t: The border fades from this colour at the top…
cobblecomfort.option.look.padding.desc: Space between the content and the panel edge.
cobblecomfort.option.look.name_color.des: Colour of the block or entity name.
cobblecomfort.option.look.detail_color.d: Colour of detail lines without their own colour.
cobblecomfort.option.look.bar_gap.desc: Distance between the panel and the health/armor bars in GUI pixels. The default leaves room for the held item name.
cobblecomfort.option.look.animation.desc: How the panel appears when you look at something and disappears when you look away.
cobblecomfort.option.look.animation_dura: Length of the show/hide animation in seconds.
cobblecomfort.option.look.linger_time.de: Seconds the panel stays after you look away, so it does not flicker.
Animate the panel size when the target changes.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.enabled.des: Remembers what is in every container you open, so you can search for items later and find the container again.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.chests.desc: Chests (also double and trapped chests, copper chests), barrels and placed shulker boxes.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.ender_chest: Your ender chest contents, once per world or server, no matter which ender chest you open.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.utility_blo: Furnaces, blast furnaces, smokers, hoppers, dispensers, droppers and brewing stands.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.entities.de: Chest and hopper minecarts, chest boats and donkeys, mules and llamas with chests. Their position is updated when you see them.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.forget_brok: Containers that are no longer there (broken, picked up) are forgotten as soon as their area is loaded.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.inventory_h: While searching in an inventory, shows in how many remembered containers the item is too. Click it to see them.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.count_shulk: Items in shulker boxes inside containers are counted and found too.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.ender_toolt: Hovering an ender chest item shows its remembered contents like the shulker preview (style settings from the shulker preview).
cobblecomfort.storage.ender_unknown: Contents unknown: open your ender chest once
cobblecomfort.option.storage.show_age.de: Shows how long ago a container was last opened. Old contents are marked in orange, as they may have changed.
After this many days, a container's contents count as possibly outdated.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.naming.desc: A pencil next to the title of an open container lets you give it a name (e.g. "Ores"). Names are shown in search and look info and can be searched for.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.highlight_s: How long containers chosen in the search stay marked. Opening a marked container unmarks it.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.outline.des: Marked containers get a glowing outline with name and distance, visible through walls.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.outline_col: Colour of outline, compass arrow and map markers.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.compass_arr: A small arrow next to the crosshair points to the nearest marked container, with its distance.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.map_markers: Marked containers are shown on the map and minimap.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.map_all.des: Shows every remembered container on the full map, not only marked ones.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.look_info.d: Looking at a remembered container shows its contents in the look info.
cobblecomfort.option.storage.look_info_r: How many rows of 9 items the look info shows at most.
cobblecomfort.storage.title: Storage Memory
cobblecomfort.storage.nothing_yet: Nothing remembered yet: open some chests!
cobblecomfort.storage.hint.items: Click an item to see where it is
cobblecomfort.storage.hint.containers: Click: mark · Right click: on the map
cobblecomfort.storage.name: Name
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.enabled.desc: Highlights item slots in the colour of the item's rarity, like the colour of its name.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.in_inventori: Player inventory, chests, furnaces, trading and all other container screens.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.in_hotbar.de: Show the indicator in the hotbar.
Show the indicator in the creative menu.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.tooltip_fram: Colour the item tooltip frame by rarity. Items with a custom tooltip style keep it.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.min_rarity.d: Only items of this rarity or higher get an indicator.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.thickness.de: Line thickness of the frame and underline styles.
Size of the triangle in the corner style.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.common_color: Only used if the minimum rarity is Common.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.pulse_from.d: Only items of this rarity or higher pulse.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.pulse_streng: How much the intensity drops at the low point of a pulse.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.shimmer.desc: A light streak sweeps diagonally across the slot every few seconds.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.shimmer_from: Only items of this rarity or higher shimmer.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.hover_highli: Make the indicator brighter and thicker while the mouse is over the slot.
cobblecomfort.option.rarity.rainbow_epic: Epic items cycle through all colours instead of purple.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.enabled.desc: Zoom in with a key (default C, change it in Controls). Scroll while zooming to zoom further in or out.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.toggle_mode.de: Press once to zoom in and again to zoom out, instead of holding the key.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.zoom_factor.de: How far you zoom in when you press the key.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.scroll_zoom.de: The mouse wheel zooms further in or out while zooming, instead of switching hotbar slots.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.scroll_step.de: How much one scroll step changes the zoom.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.min_zoom.desc: Scrolling out stops at this zoom level.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.max_zoom.desc: Scrolling in stops at this zoom level.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.reset_on_relea: Start at the configured zoom level every time. When off, the last scrolled level is kept.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.smooth_transit: Glide in and out instead of jumping straight to the zoom level.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.transition_spe: How fast the smooth zoom follows. Higher is faster.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.style.desc: Normal: just zoom. Cinematic: black bars slide in at the top and bottom of the screen.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.bar_height.des: Height of each cinematic bar relative to the screen height.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.bar_color.desc: Colour and transparency of the cinematic bars.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.bar_duration.d: Seconds the bars need to slide in or out. 0 shows them instantly.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.bar_easing.des: The curve of the bar animation.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.spyglass_overl: Show the spyglass mask while zooming.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.adjust_sensiti: The further you zoom in, the slower the mouse turns, so aiming stays precise.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.sensitivity_st: 100% slows the mouse exactly in proportion to the zoom; lower values slow it less.
Turn on vanilla's cinematic camera smoothing while zooming.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.hide_hand.desc: Hide your hand and held item while zooming.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.hide_hud.desc: Hide the whole HUD while zooming.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.show_zoom_leve: Briefly show the zoom level (e.g. 6.0×) below the crosshair when you scroll.
cobblecomfort.option.zoom.zoom_level_dur: Seconds the zoom level stays visible after scrolling.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.enabled.desc: Shows your armor with its durability next to the hotbar. Move and scale it in the HUD editor.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.show_arrows.d: While holding a bow or crossbow, show how many arrows you have.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.show_empty_sl: Show an outline for armor slots without armor.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.layout.desc: Horizontal: a row with durability below. Vertical: a column with durability to the right.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.spacing.desc: Distance between two pieces in GUI pixels.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.color_by_dura: Colour the durability from green over yellow to red, like the vanilla durability bar.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.text_color.de: Colour of the durability text when colouring by durability is off.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.text_shadow.d: Draw the text with a shadow.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.warn_below.de: Pieces with less durability than this are highlighted.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.warn_sound.de: Play a quiet sound once when a piece drops below the threshold.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.animate_equip: Pieces fade and grow in when you put them on and out when you take them off.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.equip_duratio: Length of the equip animation in seconds.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.shake_on_dama: A piece shakes briefly when it loses durability.
cobblecomfort.option.armor.smooth_moveme: Pieces slide into place when others are added or removed.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.enabled.desc: Makes moving items in inventories more satisfying: a springy carried item, bouncing slots and falling particles.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.follow_lag.de: How much the carried item trails behind the cursor. 0% sticks to the cursor like vanilla.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.tilt.desc: The carried item leans into the direction you move it.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.pickup_pop.de: The item briefly grows and springs back when you pick it up.
How much bigger the item gets when popping.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.drop_squash.d: The slot squashes and bounces back when you put an item into it.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.slot_flash.de: The slot lights up briefly when an item lands in it.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.spread_pop.de: Slots pop one after another while you drag a stack across them to split it.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.shortcut_fx.d: Effects also for shift-click, number keys, Q and double-click, not only when moving items with the cursor.
Items moved by a shortcut fly visibly from their old to their new slot.
How long a flying item takes, in seconds.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.fly_arc.desc: How high flying items arc, in pixels. 0 flies in a straight line.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.particle_styl: Crumbs: pixels in the item's colours. Sparks: twinkles in the rarity colour. Both: crumbs plus sparks for rare items.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.sparks_from.d: With the style Both, items of this rarity or higher also sparkle.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.move_particle: The carried item sheds particles while you move it; faster movement sheds more.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.density.desc: How many particles fall off while moving.
A small burst of particles when you pick an item up.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.drop_burst.de: A small burst of particles when you put an item down.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.max_particles: Upper limit of particles on screen at once.
cobblecomfort.option.invfx.sound.desc: A quiet pop when you pick up or put down an item, with slightly varying pitch.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.enabled.des: Set goals for resources you want to collect (key K by default) and follow your progress in the HUD. Goals are saved per world and server.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.open.desc: Open the goal menu. Only available while you are in a world.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.count_shulk: Also count items inside shulker boxes you carry.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.count_bundl: Also count items inside bundles you carry.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.nearby_ches: Remember the contents of containers you open and show nearby amounts separately (+N). Only containers you have opened are known.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.nearby_radi: Containers within this many blocks count as nearby.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.nearby_coun: When on, items in nearby chests count towards completing a goal. When off, they are only shown.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.default_qua: Amount pre-filled in the goal menu.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.hide_when_e: Hide the tracker HUD when there are no goals.
Show a title with the number of completed goals.
Show item names next to the icons. Off makes the HUD narrower.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.show_bar.de: Show a progress bar per goal.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.max_rows.de: Show at most this many goals; the rest is summarised as +N.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.nearby_colo: Colour of the +N amount in nearby chests.
Draw a box behind the tracker.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.background_: Colour and transparency of the background.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.padding.des: Space between the content and the background edge.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.smooth_coun: Amounts and bars count up and down smoothly.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.bump_on_cha: The amount briefly grows when it changes.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.slide_in.de: New goals slide and fade in.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.completion_: A light sweeps across a goal when it is completed.
A burst of confetti when a goal is completed.
cobblecomfort.option.tracker.toast.desc: Show a notification in the top right when a goal is completed.
cobblecomfort.tracker.toast.title: Goal reached!
cobblecomfort.tracker.hud.title: Goals %s/%s
cobblecomfort.tracker.screen.title: Resource goals
cobblecomfort.tracker.screen.empty: No goals yet. Click an item on the right.
cobblecomfort.tracker.screen.hint_add: Left click: add %s as a goal
cobblecomfort.tracker.screen.hint_recipe: Right click: add the ingredients to craft it
Toggle full brightness with a key (default G). Works with and without shader packs.
cobblecomfort.option.fullbright.active.d: Whether fullbright is currently switched on. Same as pressing the key.
cobblecomfort.option.fullbright.method.d: Automatic: brightens the lightmap without shaders and uses a hidden client-side night vision effect while an Iris shader pack is active. Lightmap: vanilla only. Night vision: works everywhere, also brightens sky and fog like real night vision.
cobblecomfort.option.fullbright.strength: How bright it gets. 100% is full brightness.
cobblecomfort.option.fullbright.smooth_f: Fade the brightness in and out instead of switching instantly.
cobblecomfort.option.fullbright.fade_dur: Length of the fade in seconds.
cobblecomfort.option.fullbright.show_hud: Show "☀ Fullbright" while it is on. Move it in the HUD editor.
cobblecomfort.option.fullbright.toggle_m: Show a short message above the hotbar when switching.
cobblecomfort.option.fullbright.remember: Keep fullbright on after restarting the game if it was on.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.enable: Explains each enchantment in item tooltips: what it does, its max level, which items it applies to and what it conflicts with.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.displa: When the detail lines below an enchantment are shown.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.shift_: Shows a short hint below the enchantments while the details are hidden.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.show_d: What the enchantment does. Other mods' enchantments are covered when they ship a description (lang key enchantment.<mod>.<name>.desc).
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.show_m: Appends the max level to the name, e.g. Sharpness IV/V.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.max_le: Shows the max level even while the other details are hidden.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.highli: Enchantments at their max level get the max level colour.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.show_a: Which items the enchantment can go on.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.show_c: Enchantments it cannot be combined with.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.max_li: Longer item and conflict lists are cut off with "+N".
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.mark_c: Curses get a warning sign and the curse colour.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.indent: Spaces in front of the detail lines.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.wrap_w: Longer lines are wrapped at this width (in pixels).
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.label_: Colour of "Applies to:", "Conflicts:" and the max level.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.extra_: Colour of the item and conflict lists.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.max_le: Name colour of enchantments at their max level.
cobblecomfort.option.enchant_desc.curse_: Colour of curses and their description.
enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc: Mine at normal speed while underwater.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Extra damage to spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites, and slows them down.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Once worn, the item can't be taken off until you die or it breaks.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Hits with the mace ignore part of the target's armor.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: A thrown trident summons lightning on the target during thunderstorms.
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: Mace smash attacks deal more damage per block fallen.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces fire damage and burn time.
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Arrows set the target on fire.
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc: Ores and some other blocks drop more items.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Freezes water below you into ice and protects from magma blocks.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Extra damage to aquatic mobs, and to all mobs standing in water or rain.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Shooting doesn't use up normal arrows. You still need one arrow.
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc: Mobs drop more and rarer loot.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: A thrown trident flies back to you.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Better chance of treasure while fishing.
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc: Spear jab attacks push you forward. Costs hunger and durability.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: Collected experience repairs the item instead of giving you levels.
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: Shoots three arrows at once for the cost of one.
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc: Arrows pass through several mobs and can be picked up again.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Reduces damage from arrows, tridents and other projectiles.
enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc: Arrows knock the target back further.
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc: Breathe longer underwater and see better below the surface.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Throwing the trident in water or rain launches you along with it.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Mined blocks drop themselves, e.g. stone instead of cobblestone.
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc: Extra damage to undead mobs like zombies, skeletons and the Wither.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Move faster on soul sand and soul soil. Uses up durability.
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping_edge.desc: Sweep attacks deal more damage to nearby mobs.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Attackers take damage. Uses up extra durability.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: The item loses durability less often.
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: The item disappears when you die instead of dropping.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: Mace smash attacks launch you back up into the air.
Bookshelf counter and markers, enchantment chances and descriptions at the enchanting table.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.shelf_co: Shows above the enchanting table GUI how many bookshelves count (max 15).
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.max_leve: Shows the highest level the table can offer with the current shelves and how many are missing for level 30.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.world_ma: While looking at an enchanting table, marks its bookshelves and the free spots around it.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.mark_val: Bookshelves that count towards the level.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.mark_blo: Bookshelves that don't count because a block sits between them and the table.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.mark_emp: Spots where a new bookshelf would count. Only shown while fewer than 15 count.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.odds_pan: Adds a % button to the enchanting table that opens a list of all possible enchantments with their chance per slot. The chances are estimated by simulation; the real outcome is not predicted.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.panel_op: Whether the panel is open. The % button toggles it and remembers the state.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.slot_odd: When hovering a slot: the chance of getting more than the shown enchantment and the most likely extras.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.max_extr: How many likely extra enchantments the slot tooltip lists.
Rolls per slot used to estimate the chances. More is more accurate but takes longer when the item changes.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.slot_des: Description of the shown enchantment when hovering a slot. Follows the Shift setting of Enchantment Descriptions.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.panel_de: Description when hovering an entry in the panel.
cobblecomfort.option.enchanting.readable: Replaces the Standard Galactic text on the slots with the name of the shown enchantment.
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.enabled.desc: A gliding selection frame, an enlarged selected item and more for the hotbar.
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.scale_select: The selected item grows smoothly, the previous one shrinks back.
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.selected_sca: Size of the selected item (1.0 = normal).
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.grow_duratio: Roughly how long growing and shrinking takes, in seconds.
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.bounce.desc: How much the item springs when it grows. 0% grows without overshooting.
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.lift.desc: The selected item moves up a little.
How far the selected item moves up, in pixels.
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.smooth_selec: The selection frame glides to the new slot instead of jumping.
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.slide_durati: How long the frame takes to reach the new slot, in seconds.
How long the numbers stay after a slot change, in seconds.
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.dim_others.d: Items that aren't selected are slightly darkened.
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.dim_amount.d: How much the other items are darkened.
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.switch_parti: Small sparks in the item's rarity colour when the frame arrives at the new slot.
cobblecomfort.option.hotbar.particle_cou: Number of sparks per slot change.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.enabled.des: Shows what's inside shulker boxes: in the tooltip, as a HUD panel while holding one and as a fill bar on the slot.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.tooltip.des: Replaces the text list of the contents with an item grid.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.compact_by_: Normally shows a compact summary (same items added up); the full 9x3 grid appears while the key is held. Off: always the full grid.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.full_key.de: Hold this key to see every slot of the box.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.key_hint.de: Shows a small hint below the compact summary.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.sort_by_cou: The compact summary lists the most common items first.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.compact_col: Items per row in the compact summary.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.tint.desc: Tints the grid in the colour of the shulker box.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.tint_streng: How strongly the grid is tinted.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.rarity_glow: Items in the preview get the rarity indicator (if it is enabled).
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.pop_in.desc: Items pop in one after another when the preview appears.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.pop_duratio: How long one item takes to pop in, in seconds.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.stagger.des: Delay between two items popping in, in milliseconds.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.hud.desc: While you hold a shulker box, a panel shows its contents (movable in the HUD editor).
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.hud_offhand: Also shows the panel for a shulker box in the offhand.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.hud_columns: Items per row in the HUD panel.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.fill_bar.de: A small bar on shulker box slots shows how full the box is.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.fill_bar_ho: Shows the fill bar in the hotbar too.
cobblecomfort.option.shulker.fill_mode.d: Occupied slots, or items compared to what the box could hold.
Colour of the bar while the box has room left.
Colour the bar fades to as the box fills up.
Replaces the vanilla effect icons with a list showing time left, progress bars and warnings. Movable in the HUD editor ("Effects").
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.style.de: List with bars, icons with a ring timer, or compact icons with time.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.list_wid: Width of a row in the list style, in pixels.
For the icon styles: how many effects fit in one row.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.separate: Beneficial effects first, harmful ones in their own group below.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.sort.des: Order of the effects (within each group).
cobblecomfort.enum.effect_sort.name: Name
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.hide_ico: Effects whose icon is hidden (e.g. by commands or servers) stay hidden.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.backgrou: A dark panel behind each effect.
Colour and transparency of the panel.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.category: A coloured stripe shows whether an effect is beneficial or harmful.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.effect_c: Bars and rings use the potion colour of the effect. Off: the good/bad colour.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.show_lev: Shows the level (II, III, ...) of stronger effects.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.warn.des: Effects pulse during their last seconds.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.warn_sec: How many seconds before the end the warning starts.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.warn_sou: A short chime when an effect enters its warning time.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.animatio: New effects slide in, ended ones fade out and the others move up smoothly.
cobblecomfort.option.effect_hud.inventor: The effect list next to inventories uses this look too.
Hovering an effect in the inventory shows what it does.
effect.minecraft.jump_boost.desc: Jump higher and take less fall damage.
effect.minecraft.resistance.desc: Take less damage from most sources.
effect.minecraft.invisibility.desc: Become invisible. Worn armor is still visible.
effect.minecraft.blindness.desc: Your view is limited to a few blocks and you can't sprint.
effect.minecraft.night_vision.desc: See in the dark and underwater.
effect.minecraft.poison.desc: Lose health over time, but never below half a heart.
effect.minecraft.wither.desc: Lose health over time; can kill.
effect.minecraft.absorption.desc: Extra golden hearts that take damage first.
effect.minecraft.glowing.desc: You are outlined and visible through walls.
effect.minecraft.luck.desc: Better loot from chests and fishing.
effect.minecraft.unluck.desc: Worse loot from chests and fishing.
effect.minecraft.slow_falling.desc: Fall slowly and take no fall damage.
effect.minecraft.conduit_power.desc: Breathe underwater, see better and mine faster underwater.
effect.minecraft.bad_omen.desc: Entering a village turns this into Raid Omen.
effect.minecraft.hero_of_the_village.des: Villagers give you discounts and gifts.
effect.minecraft.trial_omen.desc: Trial spawners near you become ominous.
effect.minecraft.raid_omen.desc: A raid starts in the village when this ends.
effect.minecraft.wind_charged.desc: Releases a wind burst when you die.
effect.minecraft.weaving.desc: Spreads cobwebs when you die and lets you move through cobwebs faster.
effect.minecraft.infested.desc: Silverfish may come out when you take damage.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.enabled.de: Search field, sorting and lockable slots for inventories and containers.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.search.des: A search field above every container. Matching slots light up, the others are dimmed. Ctrl+F focuses it, "@mod" searches by mod.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.search_too: Also searches the tooltip text, e.g. enchantments or lore.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.search_shu: A shulker box matches if something inside it matches.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.remember_q: Keeps the search text when you open the next container.
Colour and strength of the overlay on slots that don't match.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.sort_butto: Small buttons at chests, shulker boxes and your inventory that sort that area.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.middle_cli: A middle click on a slot sorts its area (not in creative mode, where middle click copies items).
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.sort_order: How items are ordered. Stacks of the same item are always merged.
cobblecomfort.enum.sort_order.name: Name
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.sort_hotba: Sorting your inventory also rearranges the hotbar.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.actions_pe: 0 sorts instantly. Some servers with anti-cheat dislike many clicks at once; then sort slower, e.g. 2-4 actions per tick.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.sort_anima: The sorted slots pop one after another (uses the inventory effects).
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.locks.desc: Alt+click a slot of your inventory to lock or unlock it. Locked slots are never sorted. Saved per world and server.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.lock_prote: Shift-click, number keys, Q and double-click collecting don't touch locked slots. A normal click still works.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.lock_world: The drop key does nothing while a locked hotbar slot is selected.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.lock_in_ho: Shows the lock on hotbar slots too.
cobblecomfort.option.invtools.lock_color: Colour of the lock and the slot frame.
Screens pop in with a short scale and fade instead of appearing abruptly. Clicks and keys work right away, closing stays instant.
cobblecomfort.option.smooth_gui.containe: Your inventory, chests, furnaces, the enchanting table and so on.
cobblecomfort.option.smooth_gui.menus.de: Pause menu, options and other menus opened in game.
cobblecomfort.option.smooth_gui.chat.des: The chat input slides up a little.
cobblecomfort.option.smooth_gui.only_fro: Only when opened from the game
Animates screens opened from gameplay only; switching between menus (e.g. options pages) stays instant.
cobblecomfort.option.smooth_gui.duration: Length of the open animation in seconds. Short keeps it snappy.
cobblecomfort.option.smooth_gui.start_sc: Size the screen starts at (1.0 = no scaling).
cobblecomfort.option.smooth_gui.bounce.d: The screen grows slightly past its size and settles back, for a springy pop.
cobblecomfort.option.smooth_gui.fade.des: The screen fades in while it scales. Items appear halfway through.
cobblecomfort.option.smooth_gui.chat_sli: How far the chat input slides up, in pixels.
cobblecomfort.option.smooth_gui.stagger_: Container slots pop in one after another from the top left, within the animation time.
cobblecomfort.option.smooth_gui.backgrou: The background dimming and blur fade in instead of appearing at once.
How long the background takes to fade in, in seconds.
cobblecomfort.option.info_hud.enabled.de: A panel with coordinates, direction, biome, light, time, weather, FPS, ping and more. Movable in the HUD editor ("Info HUD").
cobblecomfort.option.info_hud.entries.de: The lines shown, top to bottom. Add, remove and reorder them here.
cobblecomfort.option.info_hud.other_dime: Next to the coordinates: the matching Nether position (red) in the overworld, the overworld position (green) in the Nether.
cobblecomfort.option.info_hud.direction_: Also shows the exact facing in degrees.
cobblecomfort.option.info_hud.sleep_hint: Shows next to the time when you can sleep (night or thunderstorm).
cobblecomfort.option.info_hud.color_valu: FPS and ping green/yellow/red, light level red where monsters can spawn.
cobblecomfort.option.info_hud.style.desc: Panel with icons, text only, or everything in one line.
cobblecomfort.option.info_hud.icons.desc: Small item icons in front of the lines.
cobblecomfort.option.info_hud.background: Colour and transparency of the panel.
cobblecomfort.option.info_hud.hide_with_: Hides the panel while the F3 debug screen is open.
cobblecomfort.option.info_hud.animate.de: Numbers like FPS change smoothly, lines fade in and out (e.g. ping, targeted block).
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.enabled.de: Shows saturation, exhaustion and what food would restore, like AppleSkin.
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.saturation: Golden outlines on the shanks show the hidden saturation, which is used up before the food bar.
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.eat_previe: While holding food, the shanks (and saturation) it would restore blink in the food bar.
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.exhaustion: A faint bar behind the food bar fills up until the next point of saturation or food is lost.
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.estimate_e: Servers don't send exhaustion, so it is estimated from sprinting, jumping, swimming and attacking. Exact in singleplayer.
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.numbers.de: Small "food + saturation" numbers next to the food bar.
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.hunger_war: The food bar glows red softly when food is low (at 6 or less you can't sprint).
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.warn_below: Food level (in half shanks) from which the warning starts.
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.heal_previ: While holding food, blinking hearts show roughly how much health natural regeneration will give back.
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.tooltip_va: Food items show their hunger and saturation as icons and numbers.
Marks the hotbar food that restores the most right now without waste (food with side effects like golden apples is left out).
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.exhaustion: Colour and transparency of the exhaustion bar.
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.warning_co: Colour of the hunger warning glow.
cobblecomfort.option.food_hud.best_food_: Colour of the best food marker.
cobblecomfort.food.best: Best food to eat right now
cobblecomfort.option.map.enabled.desc: World map (M), minimap, waypoints and structure markers. The explored map is saved per world/server.
cobblecomfort.option.map.minimap.desc: Shows the minimap (top right, movable in the HUD editor).
cobblecomfort.option.map.round.desc: Round minimap instead of a square one.
cobblecomfort.option.map.rotate.desc: The minimap turns with you so your view always points up. Off: north is up.
cobblecomfort.option.map.size.desc: Size of the minimap in GUI pixels.
cobblecomfort.option.map.zoom.desc: Pixels per block on the minimap.
cobblecomfort.option.map.coords.desc: Shows your coordinates below the minimap.
cobblecomfort.option.map.biome.desc: Shows the biome below the minimap.
cobblecomfort.option.map.entities.desc: Dots for nearby players and mobs.
cobblecomfort.option.map.passives.desc: Animals, villagers and other peaceful mobs (green).
cobblecomfort.option.map.mob_heads.desc: Shows the faces of mobs and players instead of dots where known. Other mobs stay coloured dots.
cobblecomfort.option.map.height_fade.des: Mobs above or below you are drawn more transparent the closer they get to the height range.
cobblecomfort.option.map.height_range.de: Mobs more than this many blocks above or below you are not shown on the minimap and map. Players are only faded.
cobblecomfort.option.map.trail.desc: Draws a line on the minimap and map showing where you walked recently (kept until you leave the world).
On servers with the Cobble Comfort Sync plugin, your position is sent to other players with the mod who share too. Only then do you see their positions on the minimap and map, even beyond render distance and in other dimensions.
cobblecomfort.option.map.view_cone.desc: A soft cone in front of your arrow shows where you are looking.
cobblecomfort.option.map.cardinals.desc: Shows E, S and W on the minimap frame as well, not just N.
cobblecomfort.option.map.cave_mode.desc: Underground, the map and minimap show a slice at your height instead of the surface.
cobblecomfort.option.map.nether_roof.des: In the Nether, the map shows the ground under the bedrock roof instead of the roof.
cobblecomfort.option.map.shading.desc: Slopes are lit and shaded, so terrain is easier to read.
cobblecomfort.option.map.grid.desc: Shows chunk borders on the full map when zoomed in.
How opaque the map is when shown as a window (switch with the window button on the map).
cobblecomfort.option.map.waypoints.desc: Waypoints on the map, minimap and in the world. B creates one, U opens the list.
cobblecomfort.option.map.beams.desc: A coloured beam of light at each waypoint in the world.
cobblecomfort.option.map.labels.desc: Shows the name and distance of waypoints in the world.
cobblecomfort.option.map.label_range.des: Waypoints further away than this (in blocks) show no label.
cobblecomfort.option.map.death_waypoints: Sets a waypoint where you died.
cobblecomfort.option.map.respawn_waypoin: Keeps a waypoint at your bed or respawn anchor: set on "Respawn point set", checked after respawning and removed when the bed is gone or the anchor empty.
cobblecomfort.option.map.max_deaths.desc: How many death waypoints are kept; older ones are removed.
Waypoints shared in chat in Xaero's format are shown readably with a click to add them. Sharing sends them in that format.
cobblecomfort.option.map.import_xaero.de: Takes over Xaero's Minimap waypoints once per world/server, if any are found.
cobblecomfort.option.map.seed_terrain.de: If the seed is known (singleplayer, /seed or entered by hand), unexplored areas are calculated and shown darkened. Only matches vanilla world generation.
cobblecomfort.option.map.unexplored_brig: How bright calculated, unexplored terrain is shown.
cobblecomfort.option.map.structures.desc: Marks villages, temples, monuments, strongholds and more on the map.
cobblecomfort.option.map.structures_seed: With a known seed, structure positions are calculated, also in unexplored areas (exact in singleplayer, otherwise a good estimate).
cobblecomfort.option.map.structures_dete: Recognises structures by typical blocks (bells, spawners, nether bricks, end portal frames, ...) and marks them.
cobblecomfort.option.map.structure_radiu: How far around you structures are calculated from the seed, in blocks.
cobblecomfort.map.title: Map
cobblecomfort.map.hint: Drag or arrow keys: move · Scroll: zoom · Right click: menu · Double click: waypoint · C: follow player · Tab: next dimension · WASD: walk
cobblecomfort.waypoint.name: Name
cobblecomfort.waypoint.none: No waypoints yet. Press B in game or double click on the map.
cobblecomfort.map.seed.title: Server seed
cobblecomfort.map.seed.hint: Enter the seed for unexplored terrain and structures.
cobblecomfort.editor.title: HUD editor
cobblecomfort.editor.disabled: The HUD customizer is turned off. Changes take effect once it is on.
cobblecomfort.editor.help: Drag: move · Scroll: scale · Right click: settings · R: reset · H: hide · Arrows: nudge · Shift: no snapping
cobblecomfort.option.chat.enabled.desc: Player heads, timestamps, stacked repeats, highlighted mentions, longer history, search and right-click copy.
cobblecomfort.option.chat.heads.desc: Shows the sender's head in front of their message.
cobblecomfort.option.chat.head_name_sear: Many servers reformat chat (e.g. "[Rank] Alex » hi"). The first online player name in the message is then used as the sender.
cobblecomfort.option.chat.timestamps.des: Time in front of every message. Hover shows date and seconds.
Identical messages in a row are merged into one line with ×2, ×3 …
cobblecomfort.option.chat.highlight_ment: Your name and your own keywords in other players' messages are coloured and the line is marked on the left.
cobblecomfort.option.chat.mention_keywor: More words, comma separated (e.g. nickname, team name). Case-insensitive.
Colour of the highlighted name and the marker.
Plays a quiet sound when you are mentioned.
cobblecomfort.option.chat.history_length: How many messages the chat keeps (vanilla: 100).
cobblecomfort.option.chat.keep_on_discon: The chat is kept when leaving or switching servers, with a separator line.
cobblecomfort.option.chat.search.desc: Search field above the input on the right in the open chat (Ctrl+F). Filters the history live.
cobblecomfort.option.chat.right_click_co: Right-clicking a message in the open chat copies its text to the clipboard.
A short list at the screen edge of items you just picked up ("+32 Cobblestone"). Same items are merged. Position and size in the HUD editor.
cobblecomfort.option.pickup_log.max_entr: How many rows are visible at once. Older ones drop out.
cobblecomfort.option.pickup_log.display_: How long a row stays after the last pickup.
cobblecomfort.option.pickup_log.show_ico: The item icon at the right end of the row.
cobblecomfort.option.pickup_log.show_tot: Shows in grey how many you now carry in total.
cobblecomfort.option.pickup_log.rarity_c: Item name in its rarity colour (colours from the Rarity feature).
cobblecomfort.option.pickup_log.animatio: Rows slide in, pop briefly when merged and slide out when fading.
cobblecomfort.option.pickup_log.backgrou: Dark rounded background behind each row.
cobblecomfort.option.furnace.enabled.des: Remembers furnaces (also blast furnaces and smokers) you look into and estimates when they are done. The clock only runs while you are nearby, because only then does the furnace work.
cobblecomfort.option.furnace.toast.desc: Popup at the top right when a furnace should be done, runs out of fuel or its output is full.
cobblecomfort.option.furnace.sound.desc: Short bell sound with the popup.
cobblecomfort.option.furnace.world_marke: Amount, item and time left (or "done") float above every remembered furnace.
cobblecomfort.option.furnace.marker_dist: Up to which distance (blocks) the label above the furnace is shown.
cobblecomfort.option.furnace.map_markers: Furnaces as map markers, ringed in their status colour: yellow running, green done, orange stopped. Also toggled in the layer sidebar.
cobblecomfort.option.furnace.minimap_mar: Also show furnaces in range on the minimap.
cobblecomfort.furnace.toast.brewing.fuel: Brewing stand out of blaze powder
cobblecomfort.furnace.loaded_time: Time only passes while you are nearby
